title: Pre-registration register: every rule, its window, and the commit that froze it
rule: no backtest number may appear on a leaderboard; a rule with no registration commit is not registered, whatever its README says

history_scope.consequence: an anchor is either resolved from a commit this checkout can read, carried forward from a register built where history was visible, or left blank - never guessed from the boundary commit

rows.name: singles-only shadow baseline (team strength, no market)
rows.markets: side (spread), then total, then moneyline - in that order
rows.window: 2026 REG weeks 3-10 for the walk-forward score; week 11 forward for the shadow record
rows.leaderboard_eligible: no - backtest numbers never enter the leaderboard
rows.gates: G1 registered; G2 chronology; G3 proper score + interval; G4 multiplicity; G5 staking withheld (no price source)
rows.content_hash_matches_registration: unresolved here: this checkout is shallow (rule text unchanged since the last build)
rows.verification_note: The register stores the SHA-256 of the rule file as committed. Rebuild this register at any time: if the hash of the rule file no longer matches the text the entry says was frozen, the rule was edited after it saw data.

rows.name: control baselines: random picks, favourites only
rows.window: every game the leaderboard scores, same window for every strategy
rows.leaderboard_eligible: no - a control is a yardstick, not a competitor
rows.gates: G3 (they define the benchmark a skill claim has to beat)
rows.content_hash_matches_registration: unresolved here: this checkout is shallow (rule text unchanged since the last build)
rows.verification_note: The register stores the SHA-256 of the rule file as committed. Rebuild this register at any time: if the hash of the rule file no longer matches the text the entry says was frozen, the rule was edited after it saw data.

rows.name: verified results feed: a row settles only when an official page printed the score
rows.window: 2026 REG weeks 1-10 as read on 2026-11-14 and 2026-11-16
rows.gates: G0 (the feed is what every other gate reads)
rows.content_hash_matches_registration: unresolved here: this checkout is shallow (rule text unchanged since the last build)
rows.verification_note: The register stores the SHA-256 of the rule file as committed. Rebuild this register at any time: if the hash of the rule file no longer matches the text the entry says was frozen, the rule was edited after it saw data.

limits: This checkout is a shallow clone (oldest visible commit 019cd8357f), so a rule that predates it cannot have its anchor re-derived here; those rows carry the value recorded by a full-history build and say so in `anchor_carried_forward`. COORDINATION.md records PR-02's rule as registered by commit 0747005 and PR-01's by 25221eb, neither of which this checkout can read: they are cited as the prior's statement, not verified here.

The anchor is the first commit that touched the file on THIS branch. A squashed merge would rewrite it, and the site's own history contains squash merges, so the anchor is a strong convention, not a tamper-proof seal.
docs/lab/control-baselines.md was registered by another session; this register indexes it rather than restating it, so the rule text a reader evaluates against is the only copy.
